palette.notes: NOT PIXEL ART (painted/filtered horror animation). Code: 22 colours on a native 576x1024 still with no hue shift; the clip is mostly blue-grey and teal with one red flash frame, then near-black.

lighting: Cold blue-grey forest fog, hard white on the face mask; one full-red flash frame as a jump-scare accent; ends dimmed to black on Slenderman.
silhouette: Hooded girl with long hair and knife, hunched predatory pose; face close-ups fill the frame; Slenderman a thin dark suit in the dark at the end.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 33.3 ms, 26.15 changes/s, inflated by camera shakes, flash and posterise flicker; poses read as a few key drawings with jitter.

texture: Digital painting with a posterised/crunchy filter and chromatic split on the red frame; not a pixel grid. A small 'FLASH' warning label in a pixel font.
camera: Mid shot, then a low crouch shot, then extreme close-ups that push into the face and a hand reaching at camera; fade down to near black.

acting.enters: Already on screen, lurking between dead trees.
acting.acts: Crouches, lunges with the knife, screams into the camera, reaches a hand at the viewer.
acting.exits: Cut to dark; Slenderman appears dim in the background as the tag.
acting.depth: Moves from mid ground to filling the frame; final figure small and dim far back.

techniques: escalate shot size: mid, crouch, face, hand at lens
single red flash frame as the scare beat
fade to near-black with a second figure in the back
feel: NOT PIXEL ART: cold fog palette + push to extreme close-up + one red flash = 8 s jump scare
for_fred: For a big reaction, escalate Fred's shot size in 3 cuts (mid, face, fin at lens) instead of animating more; end on a tiny dim figure (Pixie) in the background as the tag.
